evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime evidence within 2h is false for this cycle, so profitability, canary readiness and live readiness cannot be inferred from the repository review alone.

The checked-out worktree does not include the sanitised hourly evidence package referenced by SHA-256, so code findings could not be cross-checked against the exact latest scorecards or realised outcomes for this cycle.
Solana currently lacks a checked-in executable quote/sellability adapter, so cross-chain portability is not yet testable with symmetric current-edge evidence.
No fresh per-chain labelled dataset is present in the repository to validate calibrated positive-net-edge forecasts out of sample.

Needed next research sources: Dune for multi-wallet cohort persistence, DEX Screener for liquidity/flow confirmation, Jupiter for Solana executable route costs, Etherscan V2 for EVM wallet-route reconstruction, and DefiLlama for chain/regime context.

proposals.downside_risk: Keeping the current governance does not by itself create new opportunities, so activity may remain low until better chain-specific evidence arrives.

evidence.detail: Lines 5-24 and 61-90 define durable net profitability after costs, separate opportunities/eligible_opportunities/trades, and explicitly replace money-losing strategies even when win count is high.
Lines 399-457 evaluate strategies with money-weighted net profit, profit factor, eligible participation and explicit no-live-auto-promote output.
Lines 75-126 verify no-edge inactivity is not punished, net-losing strategies are replaced despite more wins than losses, and positive candidates remain non-live.

proposals.expected_effect: Preserves disciplined evaluation while fresher evidence is collected, reducing the risk of drifting back toward activity quotas or stale-evidence promotion.
proposals.minimum_observation: 3 fresh hourly review windows plus >=8 realised or simulated trades per reviewed strategy where available
proposals.rationale: This is the strongest part of the current design: it already measures the right objective and resists the common failure mode of forcing trades or promoting on raw win rate.
proposals.shadow_test: Across at least 3 fresh hourly windows per chain, confirm every review and scorecard still separates opportunities, eligible opportunities and trades, and that any replace/promote recommendation continues to follow net P&L, profit factor and participation rather than win count alone. Reject any workflow that treats stale or quote-only evidence as live-readiness proof.

proposals.downside_risk: Jupiter quote staleness, rate limits and routing variability can produce misleading shadow edges unless freshness and simulation bounds remain strict.

evidence.detail: Lines 269-330 intentionally fail closed on Solana by leaving gross_edge_bps, liquidity_score and sellability_score at zero and setting needs_quote_feature_adapter=True.
Lines 69-107 assert the Solana adapter does not invent current edge, produces no eligible signals, and only exposes historical wallet context.
Lines 206-220 and 231-243 surface quote-feature, liquidity, sellability and forecast gaps in SHADOW scorecards and explicitly forbid promotion from quote/simulation evidence alone.

proposals.expected_effect: Improves Solana shadow evidence quality without weakening live safety controls, making portability tests falsifiable instead of speculative.
proposals.minimum_observation: 6 fresh hourly windows and >=30 Solana observations with executable quotes
proposals.rationale: Cross-chain strategy families cannot be evaluated fairly on Solana until the lab sees chain-specific executable quotes, sellability and priority-cost inputs instead of zeroed placeholders.
proposals.shadow_test: In SHADOW only, add current Solana quote age, sellability, slippage and priority-fee features to recent observations. Over at least 6 fresh hourly windows and >=30 quoted observations, compare quote-simulated net edge with later shadow outcomes. Reject the adapter if median quote error exceeds 5 bps, realised net after recorded costs is <= 0, or exit/sell failures rise above baseline.
proposals.strategy: Solana executable quote and sellability adapter

proposals.downside_risk: Profitable-wallet mining is vulnerable to survivor bias, regime drift and crowding; copied patterns can decay once costs or competition rise.

evidence.detail: Lines 132-210 already summarise profitable wallets as anonymised, money-weighted research evidence with route counts and a warning not to auto-copy a single wallet.
Lines 213-256 already group learned strategy_patterns by class and require chain-specific shadow tests before assuming portability.
Lines 26-49 and 92-109 prioritise learned patterns, route replication and differentiated hypotheses over dependence on one selected leader wallet.
Lines 33-98 and 137-223 show production recommendations are still anchored to approved top-20 leader wallets plus copy-specific gates, so diversification beyond leader-copy remains incomplete.

proposals.expected_effect: Could diversify alpha sources away from leader selection alone and produce route/behaviour strategies that survive the loss of any one copied wallet.
proposals.minimum_observation: >=40 eligible shadow observations per chain spanning >=2 independent windows and >=2 wallets
proposals.rationale: The repository already contains the research primitives needed to learn from multiple profitable wallets and route fingerprints; the next step is converting repeated multi-wallet behaviour into bounded SHADOW hypotheses instead of broadening single-wallet reliance.
proposals.shadow_test: For each proposed cohort pattern, require evidence from >=2 independent profitable wallets, >=2 time windows and positive average net after recorded costs on each chain separately. Re-quote the current route in SHADOW and compare pattern-triggered net P&L/profit factor against the baseline leader-copy family over >=40 eligible observations. Reject any pattern that collapses back to one wallet, loses money after costs, or fails to reproduce on current quotes.

proposals.downside_risk: Lookahead leakage, stale labels, regime overfit and uneven cross-chain data quality can create a false precision advantage that disappears out of sample.

evidence.detail: Lines 74-99 define the forecast objective correctly as positive net edge after costs, with strict time ordering, calibration and regime breakdown requirements.
Lines 228-246 require both a calibrated forecast and a currently executable net edge, and abstain when uncertainty is high.
Lines 63-91 verify the forecast abstains when uncertainty is high and cannot override a missing current edge.
Lines 58-81 and 120-143 accept only forecast proposals targeted at positive_net_edge_after_costs and preserve chain_scope plus SHADOW-only asset request handling.

proposals.expected_effect: If supported by fresh labels and calibration, an abstaining forecast could improve opportunity selection and reduce low-edge participation across both Solana and EVM.
proposals.minimum_observation: >=8 time-ordered windows per chain with separate train/validation/test splits and >=50 labelled opportunities per chain
proposals.rationale: The forecast scaffolding is thoughtfully constrained, but the repository review does not include fresh labelled outcomes proving that a calibrated model improves net P&L after costs on either chain.
proposals.shadow_test: Train separate Solana and EVM models on strictly pre-decision features with time-ordered train/validation/test splits. Require positive out-of-sample net P&L after recorded costs, profit factor > 1.10, acceptable Brier/log-loss calibration and no worse largest-loss profile than incumbent shadow selectors over >=8 windows. Reject any model that depends on post-trade features or loses money net of costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Claim current profitability, canary readiness or live readiness from this cycle.
rejected_ideas.reason: Fresh runtime evidence is explicitly false, and shadow_strategy_executor.py lines 18-21 and 238-243 say quote/simulation scorecards are research evidence only, not realised P&L or promotion proof.

rejected_ideas.idea: Expand single-wallet leader copying as the main source of edge without multi-wallet corroboration.
rejected_ideas.reason: docs/STRATEGY_LAB.md lines 26-49 and strategy_lab_research.py lines 205-209 explicitly push the lab toward repeated multi-wallet behaviours and away from dependence on one selected leader wallet.

summary: The checked-in Strategy Lab is already SHADOW-first, cross-chain aware, and correctly optimises money-weighted net P&L over win count, but runtime evidence for this cycle is not fresh. I therefore do not support profitability, canary, or live-readiness claims. The highest-value next steps are to preserve the current cost-aware governance, add a chain-specific Solana quote/sellability adapter, and turn profitable-wallet cohort learning plus calibrated forecasts into falsifiable SHADOW-only experiments backed by fresh out-of-sample evidence.
